## HIGH-priority finding details

### H-1: `/ai-implement` comment instructions contradicted by "exact match" docs  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `latest/reference/labels.mdx` and `latest/reference/troubleshooting.mdx` both stated the comment "must be exactly `/ai-implement` (no extra text)."
- **Source**: `ai-implement/workflows/comment-trigger.yml:59` matches `^\/ai-implement(?:\s+([\s\S]*))?$` — any text after the token is captured, base64-encoded, and forwarded to the runner as an authoritative operator instruction that takes precedence over default gap-fill behavior.
- **Edit**: Changed both pages from "must be exactly" to "must start with," and added a Tip/note explaining that trailing text becomes an operator instruction for that run.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH (only run to surface this finding)

### H-2: Issue completion on PR merge undocumented; Jira `Merged` status missing  (2/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `latest/setup/target-repo.mdx`'s "After your first run" Tip claimed Linear closes issues via the PR body's `Fixes` reference and told Jira users to "create the same effect via Jira automation if desired." `latest/reference/labels.mdx`'s status/label tables and `latest/how-it-works.mdx`'s status-marker table omitted the terminal merge state entirely.
- **Source**: The orchestrator itself marks the issue complete via a poll-detector (`ai-implement/src/poll-merged-prs.ts:29-34`) plus a webhook optimization, draining a reconciliation queue (`src/reconcile-merged.ts:10-30`) that calls `provider.markMerged()` — moving the Linear issue to its team's Done state and stripping `Ready for Review` (`src/providers/linear.ts:720-744`), or setting Jira's `AI-Implement Status` to `Merged` (`src/providers/jira.ts:269-272`, value defined at `src/providers/jira-fields.ts:77`). Runs even for paused mappings. No Jira automation is needed — the one real requirement is adding `Merged` as an option on the custom field, which no docs page mentioned.
- **Edit**: Rewrote the Tip in `target-repo.mdx` to describe the real mechanism and added `Merged` to the Jira custom-field option list; added `Merged`/Done-state table rows and detail sections to both tabs of `reference/labels.mdx`; added a new lifecycle step and status-marker row to `how-it-works.mdx`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in both runs

### H-3: `branchPrefix`, `skillsRepo` mapping fields and `install-skills` step fully wired but undocumented  (2/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `team-repo-mappings.mdx` listed mapping fields but omitted two; `customize/custom-steps.mdx`'s built-in step accordion list omitted one step; `environment-variables.mdx` omitted the corresponding gap-fill-run variable; `reference/admin-ui.mdx`'s Projects section didn't mention either field.
- **Source**: `RepoMapping.branchPrefix` and `.skillsRepo` (`ai-implement/src/config.ts:58-61`) are persisted, validated, and exposed in the admin UI stepper and edit dialog (`src/admin-ui/pages/projects.ts:128,130,286-287,588-589`). `install-skills` is a registered built-in pipeline step (`src/pipeline/default-pipeline.ts:23-33`, wired in `pipeline-loader.ts:91`) that runs in the real default pipeline right after `clone` (`pipelines/autonomous.yml:5-7`). `AI_IMPLEMENT_SKILLS_REPO` mirrors `skillsRepo` for comment-triggered runs (`workflows/comment-trigger.yml:18`, `src/run-autonomous.ts:211`).
- **Edit**: Added `branchPrefix` and `skillsRepo` `<ParamField>`s to `team-repo-mappings.mdx`; added an `install-skills` accordion (and updated the built-in step-ID Tip) in `custom-steps.mdx`; added an `AI_IMPLEMENT_SKILLS_REPO` `<ParamField>` with a scope-Note to `environment-variables.mdx`; added a cross-linked bullet to the "New in latest" Info box in `admin-ui.mdx`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH in both runs

### H-4: `autoApprovePlans` docs contradict actual (no-op) behavior  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `team-repo-mappings.mdx` and `how-it-works.mdx` both stated that setting `autoApprovePlans` to `false` makes a human manually approve the plan before implementation starts.
- **Source**: `autoApprovePlans` is round-tripped through `ai-implement/src/config.ts:39`/`admin.ts:994-1156`/the admin UI but never read by any dispatch or poll-loop code (`index.ts`, `poll-selection.ts`, `run-planning.ts`, `runner-callback.ts` have zero references). `configuration/planning.mdx` already carried an accurate disclaimer that contradicted the other two pages.
- **Edit**: Rewrote the `team-repo-mappings.mdx` ParamField and the `how-it-works.mdx` lifecycle step to state the field is reserved/inert, matching `planning.mdx`.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH (only run to surface this finding)

### H-5: Admin UI "Secrets" panel documented as functional; it's actually a stub  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/admin-ui.mdx`'s "### Secrets" section described a dedicated Platform-group panel for browsing/creating/deleting both per-team and global secrets.
- **Source**: The `secrets` sidebar route renders the "Coming soon" stub in `ai-implement/src/admin-ui/pages/stubs.ts:76-86` (status `"partial"`) — there is no `pages/secrets.ts`. Real secret management lives in the Projects per-row panel (`src/admin-ui/pages/projects.ts:28-53,785-873`) and the Settings page's global-secrets table (`src/admin-ui/pages/settings.ts:6-180`).
- **Edit**: Added a note clarifying the sidebar entry is a placeholder pointing to Projects/Settings, and reworded the per-team/global subsections to describe where the UI actually lives rather than implying a dedicated browsing panel.
- **Priority agreement**: HIGH (only run to surface this finding)

### H-6: Feature-branch grouping (parent/child issues) has zero public documentation  (2/2 runs)
- **Docs**: No `latest/*.mdx` page mentions parent/child issue trees, feature branches, or roll-up merging (confirmed via full-text search).
- **Source**: A fully implemented feature per `ai-implement/CLAUDE.md`'s "Feature-branch grouping (parent/child issues)" section, backed by `src/feature-branch.ts` (`resolveBaseBranch`), `src/merge-up.ts` (roll-up), classification in `src/providers/linear.ts`, and wiring in `src/index.ts`. Labeling a parent issue whose children are also labeled changes dispatch behavior significantly (children PR into a shared branch, parent waits, automatic roll-up).
- **Edit**: Per the audit's no-new-pages rule, added a concise `<Note>` to `how-it-works.mdx` describing the reader-relevant behavior change and confirming ordinary single-issue runs are unaffected, rather than fabricating a dedicated page.
- **Priority resolution**: Kept HIGH per the no-downgrade rule; run-2 rated this MEDIUM (M-3 in that run's numbering) and produced no edit.

## MEDIUM-priority finding details

### M-1: `AI_IMPLEMENT_LOG_LEVEL` env var undocumented  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: Not present anywhere in `latest/configuration/environment-variables.mdx`.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/CLAUDE.md:127,202-206` — controls runner log verbosity (`summary` default vs `stream`), read as a repo/org variable inside the runner container for both orchestrator-initiated and comment-triggered runs.

### M-2: `AI_IMPLEMENT_RUNNER_LABEL` env var undocumented  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: Not present anywhere in `latest/`.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/CLAUDE.md:208-212` — overrides the `runs-on` label for the implement job (e.g. to a larger runner), with a noted security implication (grants control over which runner — and its secrets — executes the job).

### M-3: `claude-plan.yml` image allowlist doesn't auto-trust repo-owner namespace  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `latest/customize/runner-image.mdx` describes GitHub Actions image resolution without distinguishing implementation vs. planning workflows, implying uniform behavior.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/workflows/claude-implement.yml:169` and `comment-trigger.yml:171` both auto-trust `ghcr.io/${owner}/`; `claude-plan.yml:114` only trusts `ghcr.io/builddownai/` — a fork publishing its own image needs `AI_IMPLEMENT_ALLOWED_RUNNER_IMAGE_PREFIXES` for planning runs even though it doesn't for implementation runs.

### M-4: Admin API reference table omits two real endpoints  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/admin-ui.mdx`'s endpoint reference table does not list two routes.
- **Source**: `GET /api/mappings/:teamKey/sync-status/:jobId` (`ai-implement/src/admin.ts:202-211`, polls a background workflow-sync job) and `GET /api/admin/github-install-state` (`src/admin.ts:389`, backs the stepper's "Check installation" probe) are both real, working endpoints.

### M-5: `packageManager: none` edge case not documented  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `customize/custom-steps.mdx` lists `npm`/`yarn`/`pnpm` as the accepted `packageManager` values in `.ai-implement/config.yml`.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/src/pipeline/steps/install.ts:85-88` throws if `packageManager` is explicitly set to `"none"` while a `package.json` is present (the value is only meant to be an internal signal for "no package.json"); this un-listed value and its failure mode aren't covered anywhere.

### M-6: `RUNNER_MODE=local` missing from admin-UI runner-mode option lists  (1/2 runs)
- **Docs**: `reference/admin-ui.mdx`'s Runners and Reaper panel descriptions list the runner-mode toggle as `default` / `gha` / `fly` / `shadow`.
- **Source**: `ai-implement/src/runner-mode.ts:3` defines `VALID_RUNNER_MODES` as including a fifth value, `local`, which `environment-variables.mdx` documents correctly but the admin UI reference does not.

## LOW-priority findings (aggregate)

- **L-1** — `planningWorkflowFile`'s docs phrasing ("Only relevant when `planningEnabled` is `true`") is softer than the source comment ("Required when planningEnabled=true") (`ai-implement/src/config.ts:36` vs `latest/configuration/team-repo-mappings.mdx:75`) (1/2 runs)
- **L-2** — Jira's reserved `Awaiting Approval` status value exists in source (`ai-implement/src/providers/jira-fields.ts:73`) but is only present in docs as an invisible commented-out JSX block in both `target-repo.mdx` and `labels.mdx` — not a rendered gap, but worth a deliberate decision on whether to surface it (1/2 runs)
- **L-3** — `claude-plan.yml`'s own validate step doesn't read `.ai-implement/image.yml` directly; only orchestrator-forwarding delivers a per-repo pinned image to planning runs (`ai-implement/CLAUDE.md:324`), a nuance `runner-image.mdx` doesn't call out (1/2 runs)
- **L-4** — The `maxTurns`/`maxIterations`/`maxJobMinutes` "NULL means use built-in default" sentinel in `ai-implement/src/config.ts:52-57` is functionally consistent with the literal defaults `team-repo-mappings.mdx` documents (50 / 3-2 / 90) — verified as *not* a drift, noted only so a future audit doesn't re-flag it (1/2 runs)
- **L-5** — `reference/admin-ui.mdx`'s sidebar-groups `<Note>` omits five real (but stub) sidebar routes — Triggers & channels, Policies & risk, MCP server, Webhooks, Updates (`ai-implement/src/admin-ui/sidebar.ts:14-34`, `src/admin-ui/pages/stubs.ts`) — appears intentional since they're not yet functional (1/2 runs)
- **L-6** — `custom-steps.mdx`'s `post-push-review` accordion says `reviewCheckNames`/`reviewWaitPollMs`/`reviewWaitTimeoutMs` are settable "via your custom pipeline YAML," but only `reviewProviders` is actually readable from `.ai-implement/config.yml` (`ai-implement/src/pipeline/steps/install.ts:12-16`) — wording could better distinguish the two mechanisms (1/2 runs)
- **L-7** — `configuration/environment-variables.mdx`'s Fly Machines accordion doesn't mention that `RUNNER_MODE=shadow` boots both a GHA dispatch and a shadow Fly Machine per run, doubling Fly session load during shadow testing (`ai-implement/src/runner-mode.ts:64`) — noted only in the admin-ui Runners KPI description (1/2 runs)

Run 3's finding is broader (also covers the Linear side and the actively-wrong "Fixes reference" claim), so it subsumes Run 2's narrower Jira-only framing.
- **Selected edit from:** Run 3 for `target-repo.mdx` and `labels.mdx`'s Merged/Done content; Run 2 for the separate `/ai-implement` "exact match" hunk that also lands in `labels.mdx` (that's H-1, not H-2).
- **Selection reasoning:** Run 3's `target-repo.mdx` edit is required regardless of preference — Run 2 left the actively-wrong "Linear closes issues via `Fixes` reference... Jira via automation" Tip completely unchanged, while Run 3 corrected it. For `labels.mdx`, Run 3 covers both Linear (Done state) and Jira (Merged), matching the full scope of the dedup finding; Run 2's `<Warning>` component for the Jira setup requirement was semantically stronger than Run 3's plain-prose equivalent, but Run 3 was selected for completeness since Run 2 omitted the Linear side of the docs file entirely.

**Edit candidates compared:**

Run 2's Jira-only approach for `labels.mdx` (not selected):
```mdx
### Merged

Set when the PR merges. The orchestrator detects the merge either through a poll check or, if configured, a GitHub webhook delivery, and updates `AI-Implement Status` accordingly. Not changed automatically after that — treat it as the terminal state for a completed run.

<Warning>
  Add `Merged` as an option on the `AI-Implement Status` custom field before your first run — see [Jira: manual custom-field setup](/latest/setup/target-repo#jira-manual-custom-field-setup). Without it, the orchestrator's attempt to set this status on merge will fail.
</Warning>
```

Run 3's Linear+Jira approach for `labels.mdx` (selected):
```mdx
### Done (on PR merge)

When the PR merges, the orchestrator moves the issue to your team's Done state and removes the `Ready for Review` label — no action needed from you. [... Jira "### Merged" section follows with equivalent wording ...]
```

### H-3
- **Present in:** Run 2 HIGH (split across three findings: H-3 install-skills, H-4 branchPrefix/skillsRepo, H-5 AI_IMPLEMENT_SKILLS_REPO), Run 3 HIGH (single combined finding)

This is the same underlying drift — two new mapping fields plus their supporting pipeline step and env-var mirror, all shipped together — decomposed differently by categorization only.
- **Selected edit from:** Mixed per-file — Run 3 for `team-repo-mappings.mdx` and `admin-ui.mdx`; Run 2 for `custom-steps.mdx` and `environment-variables.mdx`.
- **Selection reasoning:** For `team-repo-mappings.mdx`, Run 3's `skillsRepo` entry documents the actual skill-file discovery locations and cross-references the `AI_IMPLEMENT_SKILLS_REPO` variable; both runs' `branchPrefix` entries were comparable, but Run 3 used a `<Note>` for the exception case (better scannable chunking) versus Run 2's plain trailing paragraph. For `admin-ui.mdx`, Run 3 added a correctly-formed `#param-branch-prefix` cross-link per the anchor rules, which Run 2 omitted. For `environment-variables.mdx`, Run 2's edit adds a scope-clarifying `<Note>` that matches the established pattern used by the adjacent run-caps section in the same file; Run 3 omitted it, breaking the file's internal consistency.

```mdx
<Accordion title="install-skills">
  Clones the project's configured skills repo into the workspace and makes its skills available to Claude for the run. Automatically skipped when the project mapping has no skills repo configured.
```

Run 3's `custom-steps.mdx` approach (not selected — accordion only, Tip left stale):

```mdx
<Accordion title="install-skills">
  Runs immediately after `clone`. When the project mapping's **Skills Repo** field is set, clones that repository and installs any skills it contains for Claude to use during the run. A no-op when the field is blank.

  Override to change how or where skills are sourced.
</Accordion>
```
